title: Officer points to his phone when giants come up

tellings.quote: But when you bring up giants, one of them literally went like this to me, pointed to his phone.

plain: When the subject of giants came up, a military officer silently pointed at his phone, as if to warn that someone might be listening. Tim Alberino, a researcher who claims a 12-foot giant was captured in Afghanistan, tells Jesse Michels he saw this himself. He offers it as a sign that the topic is watched and sensitive.
